correctness.rationale: The full Jacobian is orthogonally reduced to mode matrices with trace (1-r)+delta*w and determinant delta*[r+(1-r)*w]. Exact Jury bounds prove Schur stability for every mode at delta<1, uniform mode proves instability at delta>1, and equality case strictly damps w<1. Calculus classifies all C_r thresholds. Packaged standard-library checker independently verifies exact rational Jury identities and Moore-torus eigenmodes.
